lessons.title: What is Artificial Intelligence?
lessons.description: Explore the definition of AI, its historical milestones, the Turing Test, and the distinction between Narrow AI, AGI, and Superintelligence.

lessons.title: Intelligent Agents & Environments
lessons.description: Understand how AI agents perceive their world through sensors, make rational decisions, and act via actuators using the PEAS framework.

lessons.title: Problem Solving & State Space Search
lessons.description: Learn how AI models formalize problems as state graphs, evaluating Breadth-First, Depth-First, and heuristic-driven A* search algorithms.

lessons.title: Knowledge Representation & Expert Systems
lessons.description: Discover how classical AI encoded human expertise into formal logic rules, inference engines, and knowledge graphs.
